using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Tests
{
    public class AzureOpenAIServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddAzureOpenAIChatClient_RegistersIChatClientFactory_AndCallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

            var mockServiceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            mockServiceProvider.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // We will capture the factory registered in AddKeyedSingleton
            IChatClient? createdClient = null;

            // Replace AddKeyedSingleton with a test double to capture the factory
            services.AddKeyedSingleton = (string? serviceId, Func<IServiceProvider, object?, IChatClient> factory) =>
            {
                // Call the factory with our mock service provider to trigger GetService call
                createdClient = factory(mockServiceProvider.Object, null);
                return services;
            };

            // Act
            var returnedServices = AzureOpenAIServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAzureOpenAIChatClient(
                services,
                deploymentName: "deployment",
                endpoint: "https://endpoint",
                apiKey: "key");

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(services, returnedServices);
            Assert.NotNull(createdClient);
            mockServiceProvider.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }

    // Extension method to replace AddKeyedSingleton for testing
    internal static class ServiceCollectionExtensionsForTest
    {
        public static IServiceCollection AddKeyedSingleton<TService>(
            this IServiceCollection services,
            string? serviceId,
            Func<IServiceProvider, object?, TService> factory)
            where TService : class
        {
            // For testing, just add a singleton with the factory invoked with a default service provider
            services.AddSingleton<TService>(sp => factory(sp, null));
            return services;
        }
    }
}

        [Fact]

        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // We will capture the factory registered in AddKeyedSingleton
            Func<IServiceProvider, object?, IChatClient>? capturedFactory = null;

            // Use a test double for AddKeyedSingleton to capture the factory
            services.AddKeyedSingleton<IChatClient> = (string? serviceId, Func<IServiceProvider, object?, IChatClient> factory) =>
            {
                capturedFactory = factory;
                return services;
            };

            // Act
            var returnedServices = AzureOpenAIServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAzureOpenAIChatClient(
                services,
                deploymentName: "deployment",
                endpoint: "https://endpoint",

            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var mockServiceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            mockServiceProvider.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // Act - invoke the factory to trigger GetService call
            var client = capturedFactory!(mockServiceProvider.Object, null);

            // Assert that GetService was called on IServiceProvider

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Tests
{
    public class AzureOpenAIServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddAzureOpenAIChatClient_RegistersFactory_AndCallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Act
            var returnedServices = AzureOpenAIServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAzureOpenAIChatClient(
                services,
                deploymentName: "deployment",
                endpoint: "https://endpoint",
                apiKey: "key");

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(services, returnedServices);

            // Retrieve the factory registered for IChatClient from the service collection
            var serviceDescriptor = Assert.Single(services, d => d.ServiceType == typeof(IChatClient));
            Assert.NotNull(serviceDescriptor);

            // Arrange a mock IServiceProvider to verify GetService call
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var mockServiceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            mockServiceProvider.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // The factory is stored as an implementation factory delegate
            var factory = serviceDescriptor.ImplementationFactory;
            Assert.NotNull(factory);

            // Act - invoke the factory to trigger GetService call
            var client = factory!(mockServiceProvider.Object);

            // Assert that GetService was called on IServiceProvider
            mockServiceProvider.Verify(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory)), Times.AtLeastOnce);
            Assert.NotNull(client);
        }
    }
}
